# agentic-realtime

Live edits for people and agents on one document, with offline support.

Keywords: yjs,crdt,realtime,collaboration,presence,offline,agents,durable-objects,cloudflare,mcp.

- Worker: createSyncWorker({ authorize }) from "agentic-realtime/worker".
- Protocol: connect a Yjs client to /api/v1/docs/:id/ws.
- Authorship: the room logs which principal (id and kind) sent each run of text.
  Compaction keeps the log, and each named snapshot keeps a copy. The kind marks
  agent text as machine-made.
- Read it: blame() from "agentic-realtime/sdk", `agentic-realtime doc blame`,
  the doc_blame MCP tool, or GET /api/v1/docs/:id/attribution.
- Limits: the log keeps up to 4000 ranges (SYNC_ATTRIBUTION_MAX_RANGES). Older
  text then shows as unattributed. Host export and erase cover the log.

## Docs
